scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist/worker && node --test worker/tests/*.test.mjs

DB.description: Select an existing Registry D1 database or choose **Create new**. Accounts, namespaces and releases are stored here. Deployment applies pending migrations to your selected database before publishing the Worker. When reusing a Registry database, also select its matching R2 bucket.

BLOBS.description: Select an existing Registry R2 bucket or choose **Create new**. Stores WebAssembly artifacts; keep the bucket private. When reusing a Registry database, select its matching bucket. R2 must be enabled on your Cloudflare account.

GITHUB_CLIENT_ID.description: Paste the **Client ID** from a [GitHub OAuth App](https://github.com/settings/developers). Use your final Worker URL as the Homepage URL and append `/v1/auth/github/callback` for the Authorization callback URL. [Setup guide](https://github.com/liusha-com/registry#create-a-github-oauth-app).

GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Paste the **Client Secret** generated by the same GitHub OAuth App as GITHUB_CLIENT_ID. Cloudflare stores this as a Worker secret. This is an OAuth App client secret, not a GitHub personal access token.
